scripts.title: Anti Drown
scripts.script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local teleportRemote = workspace:WaitForChild("Network"):WaitForChild("Teleport-RemoteEvent")

local teleporting = false

player.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attr)
    if attr == "IsDrowning" and player:GetAttribute("IsDrowning") == true then
        if teleporting then return end
        teleporting = true

        local originalPos = rootPart.CFrame

        teleportRemote:FireServer("Aquarium")

        task.wait(0.2)
        
        rootPart.CFrame = originalPos
        teleporting = false
    end
end)

local fishes = workspace.Game.Fishes
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local highestCash = 0
    local highestFish = nil

    for _, fish in fishes:GetChildren() do
        local cash = fish:GetAttribute("CashPerSec")
        local owner = fish:GetAttribute("Owner")
        if cash and not owner and cash > highestCash then
            highestCash = cash
            highestFish = fish
        end
    end

    if highestFish then
        local fishPosition = highestFish:GetPivot().Position
        rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(fishPosition)

        local prompt = highestFish.RootPart:FindFirstChild("ProximityPrompt")
        if prompt then
            fireproximityprompt(prompt)
            local args = { buffer.fromstring("\003\001") }
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                :WaitForChild("Packets")
                :WaitForChild("Packet")
                :WaitForChild("RemoteEvent")
                :FireServer(unpack(args))
        end
    end
end)

scripts.title: owehub autofarm
scripts.features:
THIS SCRIPT DONT WORK ON XENO OR SOLARA OR ANY LEVEL 3 EXECUTOR

🚀 Main Farm (Core Farming Features)

Master OP Farm - A powerful, fully automated farming system for the entire map. The script bypasses collisions and instantly swims from fish to fish using. When your backpack is full, it automatically teleports to the spawn, sells everything, and seamlessly returns to farming in your selected biome!
Biome Selector - Choose your exact target area to farm in (Everything from Sunlight to The Abyss).
Priority Mutations - Optimizes your catches! The Auto Farm will prioritize grabbing Gold, Rainbow, and other mutated/rare fish before catching standard ones.
Collection Delay - A custom slider allowing you to slow down the catch rate for better safety and anti-cheat bypasses.
Auto Sell (Full Bag) - Automatically clears your inventory to zero the moment your bag is full, skipping all the hassle!
🤖 Automation (Progression & Utilities)

Simple Auto Rebirth - Hands-free Auto Rebirth that instantly resets your character the moment you have enough requirements.
Equip Best Multiplier - One-click feature that calculates and automatically equips your single best fish for maximum multipliers (factoring in Gold/Rainbow mutations).
Auto Spin Wheel - Automatically spins the fortune wheel for you, earning tons of passive rewards while you farm.
Targeting Filters - Toggle specifically which fish you want to hunt down first (e.g., Hammerhead, Mermaids, Goldfish).
🛒 Shopping (Economy & Gear)

Economy Controls - Remote "Sell Bag" button to clear your inventory instantly from anywhere on the map, plus a 1-click "Recover Equipment" option.
Treat Auto-Buyer - Automatically snipes your preferred baits (Worms, Spiders, Butterflies, etc.) straight from the shop the millisecond they restock.
Equipment Super-Store - A built-in, remote shop straight in the GUI! Instantly buy and equip any Oxygen Tank, Fins, or Weights without swimming to the store.
👁 Visuals (ESP & Environment)

Active Fish ESP & Filters - Accurately locates and displays the distance/rarity of fish through walls and darkness! Tracks everything from Common to Secret/Divine. Includes Toggles to filter out lower tiers like 'Common/Rare'.
Rare Catch Alert / Auto TP - Pushes a UI notification the second a Legendary/Mythical fish spawns nearby. Also includes an "Instant Snipe Rares" tool that makes your character automatically jump to the rarest catches!
Full Bright (Always Day) - Removes underwater fog and shadows, giving you 100% crystal-clear visibility even at the bottom of "The Abyss".
🛡 Safety & Misc (Exploits & Protections)

Emergency Anti-Death TP - If your oxygen runs out or you drop below 30% HP, the script intelligently emergency-teleports you back to spawn before you die, saving your loot!
Speed Hack & Jump Power - Adjust your Character's WalkSpeed, Jump Power, or even manipulate the total World Gravity! Infinite Jump is also included.
Location Memory (Save Spots) - Allows you to custom-name your X/Y/Z coordinates as "Fishing Spots", saving them locally. You can endlessly teleport back to these spots from a dropdown menu! Auto-saves automatically.
FPS Optimizer - Reduces lag by stripping away heavy textures and blocky materials, boosting your FPS for overnight AFK sessions.
